title: reslice cursor thick four pane
explanation:
### Description

Demonstrate vtkResliceCursorWidget with thick line representation in a four-pane layout.

**dataset → input → filter → visual_asset → renderer → infrastructure → scene → selection → interaction → output**

- [vtkActor](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkActor.html) — assigns the mapped geometry to the scene.
- [vtkCellPicker](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkCellPicker.html) — cell picker.
- [vtkImagePlaneWidget](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkImagePlaneWidget.html) — image plane widget.
- [vtkInteractorStyleImage](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkInteractorStyleImage.html) — interactor style image.
- [vtkOutlineFilter](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkOutlineFilter.html) — generates a bounding box outline of the input data.
- [vtkPolyDataMapper](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkPolyDataMapper.html) — maps polygonal data to graphics primitives.
- [vtkProperty](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkProperty.html) — property.
- [vtkResliceCursor](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkResliceCursor.html) — reslice cursor.
- [vtkResliceCursorThickLineRepresentation](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkResliceCursorThickLineRepresentation.html) — reslice cursor thick line representation.
- [vtkResliceCursorWidget](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkResliceCursorWidget.html) — reslice cursor widget.
- [vtkVolume16Reader](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkVolume16Reader.html) — volume16reader.
- [vtkRenderWindow](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderWindow.html) — displays the rendered scene in a window on screen.
- [vtkRenderWindowInteractor](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderWindowInteractor.html) — captures mouse and keyboard events.
- [vtkRenderer](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderer.html) — assembles the scene and configures the camera.
- `Initialize()` and `Start()` launch the interactive visualization — `Initialize()` prepares the interactor and `Start()` begins the event loop.
